what_happened.line: A motion to grant a special permit for displaying eight used vehicles for sale at 10 Mass Ave, with conditions, was made and seconded; the result is not audible in the captions.
The conditions discussed were set hours, lighting checked with the building inspector, off-site repairs and detailing, a vehicle cap, a 20-foot setback and a corrected landlord letter.
With four of five members present, the applicant chose to proceed, which meant any approval had to be unanimous.
Board members questioned the mismatched street addresses, the site plan that was not to scale, and the setback before deliberating without resolution.
